subject: general
question:
What is the total surface area of the visible faces in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/523ae29475da3a0fcdf607f71185cea025a865ce0e678c4577ac1bb149a35b18.png]
solution:
**Concept Used:**

To find the area of visible faces, we have to take the area of 2 sides

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2924b8b7c8fbba2254befe6af3755d9fc7ad562e711ea3e447b66af48540eecf.png] 

Area of ABJI = (15 × 7) cm²

⇒ 105 cm²

Area of IJGH = (7 × 5) cm²

⇒ 35 cm²

Area of BCLK = (13 × 8) cm²

⇒ 104 cm²

Area of KLEF = (13 × 5) cm²

⇒ 65 cm²

Area of KFGJ = (5 × 7) cm²

⇒ 35 cm²

Area of CDEL = (8 × 5) cm²

⇒ 40 cm²

Total area of visible faces = (105 + 35 + 104 + 65 + 35 + 40) cm²

⇒ 384 cm²

**∴ Total area of visible faces is 384 cm²**
